restoration_timing: Train normally from pristine. selection: Choose by development equity only, requiring improvement over both cash and pristine frozen. Evaluate the selected variant once on the subsequent test; show all arms for audit, with no test-based reselection or automatic deployment.
limitations: Same small fixed cohort and indicative DEX costs; unavailable inventory retains the declared stress valuation. No monthly or live-profit claim.
